changes.newValue:
# IELTS Writing Grading Permission Retrospective

## Incident

Teachers opening `Grading -> IELTS Writing` saw `Missing or insufficient permissions` and the queue failed with a retry state.

## Affected Feature Surfaces

- Queue page: `TeacherGradingPage` -> `getPendingSubmissions()`
- Detail page initial load: `WritingGradingPage` -> `getSubmission()`
- Save path pre-read: `updateGrading()` reads the same submission before `updateDoc()`

## Root Cause

Two separate integration gaps compounded into one teacher-facing failure:

1. The queue query fetched all `writing_submissions` with `markingStatus == 'pending-review'`, then filtered by teacher on the client.
2. Firestore rules for `writing_submissions` used per-document teacher ownership checks.
3. Firestore rejects a collection query when any returned document is unreadable, so the whole teacher query failed.
4. Live-session auto-submit wrote `context.type` and `context.sessionCode` but did not reliably persist teacher ownership metadata.
5. The local rule fix did not affect the running app until Firestore rules were deployed to the active hosted Firebase project.

## Fix Applied

- Broadened `writing_submissions` read rules so the teacher queue query can execute without query-wide rejection.
- Tightened the update rule compared with the previous fully-open `allow update: if request.auth != null` state.
- Updated live-session auto-submit to persist `context.assigningTeacherId` from the best available teacher source.
- Deployed Firestore rules to the active Firebase project `temp-a1437`.

## Reusable Findings

- A local Firestore rules change is not a fix until the active project receives a rules deploy.
- If a teacher-facing queue relies on client-side ownership filtering, the corresponding Firestore read rule must allow the full query result set.
- In the IELTS writing flow, queue, detail load, and grading save all depend on the same `writing_submissions` read surface.
- Hosted Firebase incidents must be debugged against the active project, not just local source code.

## Current Feature State

- Queue page now depends on deployed broad authenticated reads on `writing_submissions` plus client-side teacher filtering.
- Detail page and grading save still read from `writing_submissions`, so future permission regressions in that collection will break more than one grading surface.
- New live-session submissions should now persist `context.assigningTeacherId`.
- Historical submissions created before the metadata fix may still exist without teacher ownership fields, but broad read rules prevent that from blocking teacher access.

## Verification

- Console logs confirmed the failing call site was still `getPendingSubmissions()`.
- `src/services/writingSubmissionService.test.ts` passed after the fix.
- Firestore rules were deployed successfully to `temp-a1437` and remote read-back confirmed the updated `writing_submissions` rule block.
- Emulator security coverage could not be run end to end in this environment because Firebase emulator execution requires Java.

## Related Knowledge

- @doc/patterns/pattern-firestore-rules-vs-collection-queries
- @doc/architecture/test-system-architecture
- @doc/patterns/writing-grading-pipeline

## Source

- @task-jtjism
- @task-ekgnn8
- @task-g5yfeo
- @task-nykvop
- Incident investigation and live rules deploy on 2026-03-28.
